detailed_descriptions.en: Fight 1-8 Friends online with words in this fast paced platform fighter. Use voice recognition to perform various moves or spit out one liners to power up and knockout your friends. Choose from a roster of 27 distinct characters, each with their own signature moves and mechanics. Master your fighter’s abilities to launch opponents out of the arena. Be the last one standing, and claim your title as the ultimate smack talker! Battle across 10 distinct stages, with 6 additional stage variants! (╯'□')╯︵ ┻━┻
